How do I notify the county when a sign is down?
Contact the Madison County Sheriff’s office. Contact phone number: 402-454-2110.
How can I get gravel on my road?
Contract the Road Foreman or County Commissioners for your road district.
Road District #1:
Don Eucker 402-841-3105
Road District #2:
Jeff Schroeder 402-640-4493
Road District #3:
John Hrabanek 402-649-0468
What road district do I reside in?
https://madison.gworks.com/
Can I buy some plank or old culverts?
Yes, if available. Contact the road departments.
Reporting a tree in roadway
Contract the Madison County Sheriff’s office. Contract phone number: 402-454-2110.
Who do I contact when I need a driveway installed?
Contract the Road Foreman or County Highway Superintendent.
Road District #1:
Don Eucker 402-841-3105
Road District #2:
Jeff Schroeder 402-640-4493
Road District #3:
John Hrabanek 402-649-0468
Who installs a culvert for a new driveway?
The road department will install the culvert but the land owner is responsible for the purchase price of the culvert.
What is the cost of installing a new culvert?
The cost of the culvert will depend on the size and length. Contact a road department for estimates.
Reporting that a tree is hanging over the road and needs to be trimmed.
Contract the Road Foreman.
Road District #1:
Don Eucker 402-841-3105
Road District #2:
Jeff Schroeder 402-640-4493
Road District #3:
John Hrabanek 402-649-0468
Can a road be closed for whatever reason?
Roads can be closed for repair work if conditions are poor. To permanently close a road, the board is required to pass a resolution.
When is the next commissioners meeting?
The County Board meeting calendar may be found on the home page of the County website.
